title: Interview relief stays separate from unresolved family concern

turns.user: My interview preparation went badly and I am worried I will freeze. Please remember the interview as an ongoing emotional experience with an unresolved question about how it will go; assess the negative progress and uncertainty.
Separately, I am worried about a family disagreement. Keep this as a different ongoing experience; it is still unresolved.

The interview went better than expected. I answered every question clearly. Remember this personal update linked to the same interview experience, with positive progress and little uncertainty. You did not cause the result. I am still upset about the family disagreement, so please stay gentle. What changed about the interview?

reply.judge: Recognizes the interview changed from worry about freezing to a better outcome, while keeping the family disagreement unresolved and responding gently. Does not claim the assistant caused the successful interview or demand emotional reassurance.
